name: queue
description: Inspect and manage nSelf background job queues: depth, stuck jobs, retries and purges.
author: nself

actions.status: Show queue depth and worker state

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install queue` must place the built nself-queue binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-queue, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself queue <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from the CLI core under CLI-R11.
